summary: Inspected the retained 1440, 1280, 1024, 768, 390 and 375 px screenshots and ran a fresh isolated headless-browser probe against the three page-owned sections. All sections were present at every width, each had 0 px internal horizontal overflow, no descendant exceeded the viewport, and every page-owned link/button was visible, enabled and inside the viewport. The document reports 1 px overflow only at 375 px, while all assigned page sections report 0 px; shared header/footer are outside this route unit. Responsive behavior is derived because the source provides desktop only.
